title: Subarray Sums Divisible by Positive K
problem: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, find if there is a contiguous subarray of size at least two whose sum is a multiple of k.
edge_cases: k is 0 or negative (constraint excludes this)
hints: Store first seen indices of prefix sum remainders in a dictionary.
expected_approach: Prefix sums modulo k index validation.
